{"id":1848894150,"question_id":4085,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1765078067,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"844 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1848894150/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Largest Prime from Consecutive Prime Sum","memory":"222.2 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<bool> primegen(int n)\n    {\n        vector<bool>primes(n+1 , true);\n        primes[0] = primes[1] = false;\n\n        for(int i = 2 ; i * i <= n ; i++){\n            if(primes[i])\n            {\n                for(int j = i*i ; j <= n ; j +=i){\n                    primes[j] = false;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return primes;\n    }\n    \n    int largestPrime(int n) {\n        if(n < 2) return 0;\n        vector<bool>isPrime = primegen(n);\n\n        vector<int>primes;\n        for(int i=2 ; i<=n ; i++){\n            if(isPrime[i]) primes.push_back(i);\n        }\n        \n        vector<long long>primesum(primes.size() , 0);\n        primesum[0] = primes[0];\n\n        for(int i = 1 ; i <primes.size() ; i++){\n            primesum[i] = primesum[i-1] + primes[i];\n        }\n        \n        int maxi = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i < primesum.size() ; i++){\n            long long s = primesum[i];\n            if(s > n) break;\n            if(s >= 2 and s <= n and isPrime[s]) maxi = s;\n        }\n    return maxi;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"largest-prime-from-consecutive-prime-sum","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1248}
